device.autoReconnect: The device connects automatically when it joins the same Wi‑Fi network.

sync.heading: Sync
sync.clipboardSub: Text you copy is shared automatically between both devices.
sync.muteOnCallSub: When your phone rings, this computer’s sound is muted and restored when the call ends.

toast.pairFailed: Could not pair with {device}, please try again
toast.unpaired: {device} was removed from your paired devices.
toast.ringFailed: Couldn’t ring {device}. In KDE Connect on the phone, check that the “Ring my phone” plugin is enabled and has its permissions for Tatar.

popover.dropHint: Drag a file here to send it
popover.noDeviceSub: Open Tatar to pair a device.

settings.title: General
settings.notifyBattery: Notify when device battery drops below 15%
settings.shareBatterySub: You will see the computer’s charge on your phone.
settings.autoConnect: Connect automatically on the same network
settings.autoConnectSub: If off, you start the connection manually.
settings.troubleshootSub: Checks the common reasons a phone does not show up.
settings.shortcutsHint: These shortcuts work everywhere, even while Tatar is in the background.
settings.winNote: On Windows, Ctrl is used instead of ⌘.
settings.shortcutTaken: This shortcut is already assigned to another action.
settings.shortcutFailed: This shortcut could not be registered; another app may be using it.
settings.aboutText: An open-source desktop client compatible with the KDE Connect protocol. Named after the Ottoman post couriers who carried news from station to station.
settings.diagCopied: Diagnostic log copied to the clipboard.
settings.diagFailed: Could not copy the diagnostic log.

states.unpairBody: This device will no longer be able to send files, clipboard or notifications. You will need to pair again to use it.
states.noDevicesBody: Open KDE Connect on your phone and join the same Wi‑Fi network.

pairing.outBody: Check that the code shown on your phone matches the one below, then confirm on the phone.
pairing.inBody: Make sure you see the same code on your phone. If the codes differ, reject the request.
pairing.waiting: Waiting for confirmation on the phone…
pairing.successBody: {device} is now one of your trusted devices. It connects automatically when you are on the same network.
pairing.statusUnpaired: Not paired · on the same network

onboarding.intro: Moves files and the clipboard between your phone and computer, shows battery status and mutes sound during calls.
onboarding.step1Title: Install KDE Connect on your phone
onboarding.step1Body: Free on Google Play or F-Droid.
onboarding.step2Body: Needed to find devices on the same Wi‑Fi.
onboarding.step3Body: Your computer and phone must be on the same network.
onboarding.needPhone: KDE Connect is required on your phone.
onboarding.searching: Looking for devices on your network…
onboarding.searchingHint: Make sure KDE Connect is open on your phone.

troubleshoot.title: Troubleshoot connection
troubleshoot.introIdle: Tatar checks the common reasons your computer might not find your phone, one by one.
troubleshoot.introRunning: Running the checks in order, please wait…

wifi.title: Wi‑Fi connection
wifi.fail: You are not connected to a Wi‑Fi network

localNetwork.title: Local network permission
localNetwork.fail: Not granted. Devices cannot be found.
localNetwork.warn: Could not determine the permission state
localNetwork.noteMac: Open System Settings › Privacy & Security › Local Network and allow Tatar.
localNetwork.noteWin: Open Settings › Privacy & security and allow network access.

firewall.title: Firewall
firewall.noteMac: In System Settings › Network › Firewall, allow incoming connections for Tatar.
firewall.noteWin: In Windows Security › Firewall & network protection › Allow an app, allow Tatar.

discovery.title: Device discovery
discovery.warn: No broadcast received in the last 30 s. “AP isolation” may be on in your router.
discovery.noteMac: Open your router’s wireless settings, turn off “AP isolation”, then run the check again.
discovery.noteWin: Open your router’s wireless settings, turn off “AP isolation”, then run the check again.

phoneApp.title: Phone app
phoneApp.fail: KDE Connect on the phone is not responding
phoneApp.warn: KDE Connect on the phone is slow to respond

troubleshoot.summaryHint: The steps below usually fix it; if not, you can add the device manually.
troubleshoot.allGood: Everything looks fine. If the device still does not show up, you can add it manually.
troubleshoot.tried: A connection request was sent to {ip}. You may need to confirm on the phone.

notify.startFailedKeychain: Tatar couldn't access its key in the Keychain. The app will quit so your pairings are not lost. Reopen Tatar and click "Always Allow" when the Keychain asks.
notify.startFailedBody: Tatar couldn't start networking. If KDE Connect is running on this computer, quit it and reopen Tatar.
notify.callBody: This computer’s sound will be restored automatically when the call ends.
notify.callLoweredBody: This computer’s sound will return to normal when the call ends.
notify.pairBody: {device} wants to pair with this computer. Verification code: {code}
notify.textReceivedBody: Text from {device} was copied to the clipboard.
